name: Glow
description: A soft coloured halo that hugs the surface's edge, brightest against the window and fading out over the glow size. It follows the frame's corners, rounded or squared, and dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Glow strength
parameters.description: Intensity of the halo at the window edge

parameters.name: Glow size
parameters.description: How far the halo reaches from the edge (px)

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding the halo follows (px). The halo traces this radius on the window frame. A Border pack earlier in the chain paints its band from its own corner radius out to that radius plus its border width, so match this to the sum for the two to meet. At a border radius of 0 the band stays square and nothing sits further out.

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. Every pack in the chain that offers this setting follows one answer, so their bottom corners are all rounded or all square. Set it on any pack and the whole chain follows. Where two packs have it set differently, the one earliest in the chain wins.

parameters.name: Tint with theme background
parameters.description: Tint the halo with the system background colour (keeping its alpha) so it tracks the theme instead of a fixed colour.
